name: openlaunch
description: Connect agents to openlaunch devices through explicit, per-device grants and inspect device action results.

interface.longDescription: Use openlaunch to inspect devices and request approved device functions. New connections cover all device functions unless excluded; owners manage access policies, and existing selected-function connections retain their grants. Check every action receipt for its final outcome.
defaultPrompt: List my openlaunch devices and report their connection status.
Check the result of this openlaunch action receipt.
